heading2.$description: Text style `heading2` (inter, 18, 600), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight.

extraLargeText.$description: Text style `extra-large-text` (inter, 18, 400), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight. The root search field reads this size: reading `cap.input` 13.5pt implies 18.6 px (Derived; the field's own class is not in the Text table).

extraLargeTextStrong.$description: Text style `extra-large-text-strong` (inter, 18, 500), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight.

largeText.$description: Text style `large-text` (inter, 16, 400), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight.

largeTextStrong.$description: Text style `large-text-strong` (inter, 16, 500), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight.

text.$description: Text style `text` (inter, 13, 400), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight. List row titles and subtitles (line height 1.8 in a row), settings labels, buttons. Reading `cap.rowTitle` 9.5pt implies 13.1 px at Inter's 0.727 cap height.

textStrong.$description: Text style `text-strong` (inter, 13, 500), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight.

smallText.$description: Text style `small-text` (inter, 11, 400), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight. Section headers (`List.SectionHeaderTitle` uses small-text, secondary colour), descriptions, badges, key caps. Reading `cap.sectionHeader` 8pt implies 11.0 px.

smallTextStrong.$description: Text style `small-text-strong` (inter, 11, 500), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight.

miniText.$description: Text style `mini-text` (inter, 8, 400), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight.

miniTextStrong.$description: Text style `mini-text-strong` (inter, 8, 500), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight.

monoText.$description: Text style `mono-text` (mono, 13, 400), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight.

monoTextStrong.$description: Text style `mono-text-strong` (mono, 13, 600), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight.

smallMonoText.$description: Text style `small-mono-text` (mono, 11, 400), with the letter spacing the `text` CSS module sets for that size and weight.

20.$description: Radius 20. Declared `--radius-20: 20px` on `:root`.

full.$description: Pill and circle radius (switches, badges, the action-bar pills, alert buttons). Declared `--radius-full: 9999px` on `:root`.

window.$description: The window corner on macOS 26, the version this Mac runs (`[macos="26"]:root{--radius-window:var(--radius-window-macos-26)}`; macOS 27 uses 20). Declared `--radius-window-macos-26: 26px` on `:root`.

listItem.$description: List row corner on macOS: the List item passes `{windows:6, macOS: size === 'large' ? 12 : 10}` to its radius helper (standard-list-item.namespace-*.js). The corner fit on the selected root row reads 9.25pt (reading `radius.row`).

width.$description: Launcher width. At the interface size the owner uses, --zoom is 1, so --spx is 1px (the launcher measures 750 pt wide, as `--main-window-width` gives at zoom 1). Declared `--main-window-width: round(calc(750 * var(--spx)), 1px)` on `:root`.

expandedHeight.$description: Launcher height when expanded (the owner's Window Mode). At the interface size the owner uses, --zoom is 1, so --spx is 1px (the launcher measures 750 pt wide, as `--main-window-width` gives at zoom 1). Declared `--main-window-expanded-height: round(calc(475 * var(--spx)), 1px)` on `:root`.

header.$description: Launcher search header on macOS (the selected row's top sits at 64 pt, reading `box.row`). At the interface size the owner uses, --zoom is 1, so --spx is 1px (the launcher measures 750 pt wide, as `--main-window-width` gives at zoom 1). Declared `--main-window-header-height: round(calc(64 * var(--spx)), 1px)` on `[macos]:root`.

footer.$description: Window footer (action bar) on macOS. At the interface size the owner uses, --zoom is 1, so --spx is 1px (the launcher measures 750 pt wide, as `--main-window-width` gives at zoom 1). Declared `--default-window-footer-height: round(calc(44 * var(--spx)), 1px)` on `[macos]:root`.

windowHeader.$description: Default window header (Settings, AI Chat, Notes). At the interface size the owner uses, --zoom is 1, so --spx is 1px (the launcher measures 750 pt wide, as `--main-window-width` gives at zoom 1). Declared `--default-window-header-height: round(calc(52 * var(--spx)), 1px)` on `:root`.

listRow.$description: Root search row height. Set inline by script (`--list-item-height`), so read from pixels: reading `size.row` 38pt in both themes.

listInset.$description: Gap between the window edge and a row's fill: the selected row is 734x38pt in the 750 pt window (reading `box.row`).

settingsSidebar.$description: Settings window sidebar: an inset panel 9 pt in from the window edge, reading `size.sidebar` 225pt.

settingsWindow.$description: Settings window width as it opened (reading `size.window.settings` 800x864pt).

focusRing.$description: Focus ring width on macOS (`--focus-ring: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--color-border-focus-ring)`). Declared `--focus-ring-width: 2px` on `:root`.

focusRingOffset.$description: Focus ring offset on a switch (`.switch__root:focus-visible{outline-offset:2px}`); text fields and dropdowns draw the ring at 0.

hairline.$description: Hairline on a 2x display (`@media (resolution>=2x){:root{--half-pixel:.5px}}`). Declared `--half-pixel: .5px` on `:root` in `@media (resolution>=2x)`.

small.$description: Small button, text field, dropdown and medium token (`height:var(--space-24)`).

medium.$description: Medium button and default text field and dropdown (`height:var(--space-32)`); the settings sidebar search and selected row measure 32 pt (readings `size.sidebarSearch.h`, `size.sidebar.selected`).

actionButton.$description: Action bar button on macOS (`[macos] .action-button__button{height:round(calc(28 * var(--spx)), 1px)}`).

easeOutBack.$description: Ease-out back (overshoots; the macOS 27 glass button press). Declared `--easing-ease-out-back: cubic-bezier(.34, 1.56, .64, 1)` on `:root`.

switchThumb.$description: The switch thumb's slide on macOS (`--switch-thumb-transition: transform .366s cubic-bezier(.16, -.12, .29, 1.31)`).

control.$description: Button background and opacity change (`.base-button__root{transition:background-color .15s ease-out,opacity .15s ease-out}`).

switchTrack.$description: Switch track colour on macOS (`--switch-transition: background-color .216s ease-out`).

switchThumb.$description: Switch thumb slide on macOS, with easing.switchThumb.

reducedMotion.$description: Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, 37 rules across the stylesheets set `transition:none` or `animation:none` (spinners, progress bars, the dictation HUD, cloud-sync status, composer panels); there is no global switch, so the list, switch and button transitions above still run. Separately, `:root:not(.transitions-ready) *{transition:none!important}` keeps a window from animating while it first paints.

hotkeyHint.$description: The number-key hint that slides into a list row (`--item-number-hotkey-hint-duration:.15s`, after a .4s delay).

panel.$description: Panel shadow on macOS (popovers, the action panel): five stacked soft layers. Declared `--shadow-panel-shadow: 0 1px 1px -1px #0000000d, 0 4px 2px -3px #0000000d, 0 8px 4px -6px #0000000d, 0 12px 40px -12px #0000001a, 0 24px 64px -24px #0003` on `[macos]:root`.

page.$description: The launcher window as painted: `--color-window-bg: var(--bg-40)` with a vertical gradient to `--color-window-bg-secondary` over the macOS window material, so no declaration gives it. Use this as the page colour. Reading `px.window.main`.

settingsPage.$description: The Settings window as painted, behind its cards. Reading `px.window.settings`.

surface.$description: Settings card fill: `.settings-ui__sectionContent{background-color:rgb(from var(--fg) r g b / 2.5%)}`.

sidebar.$description: The Settings sidebar as painted. Reading `px.sidebar`.

windowBase.$description: Declared window base colour; not what the window paints (see page). `--color-window-base: #fff` on `.theme-root[light]`.

focus.$description: Focus ring colour on macOS: `--color-border-focus-ring: rgb(from var(--fg) r g b / 30%)`, drawn 2 px wide (core.size.focusRing).

inputField.$description: White at 5% in both themes. `--color-surface-input-field: #ffffff0d` on `.theme-root`.

default.$description: `--accent: var(--color-system-accent, var(--theme-accent))`: the theme's accent unless macOS supplies one. The switch track paints #158AF2 (reading `px.switch.on`), so on this Mac the theme accent is in use.

pressed.$description: Pressed switch track: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent), white 10%)`, worked out.

danger.$description: Errors, destructive buttons (`.base-button[data-variant=destructive]` on red-20), invalid fields (red-40 border).

brand.$description: Raycast's red, the same in every theme. `--color-brand: #ff6363` on `.theme-root`.

subtitle.$description: Row subtitle and accessory, text style `text`.

width.$description: Medium switch on macOS (`--switch-width: round(calc(36 * var(--spx)), 1px)`); reading `size.switch` 36x16pt.

thumbWidth.$description: Medium switch thumb on macOS (`--switch-thumb-width`); 13 px tall (16 less 1.5 px padding each side at 2x).

onBg.$description: `.switch__root[aria-checked=true]{background-color:var(--accent)}`; fg at 30% when the window is not key.

height.$description: Medium button; mini, small and large are core.size.control.*.

padding.$description: Medium button inline padding (`.button-primitive__root[data-size=medium]{padding-inline:var(--space-16)}`; 12 beside an icon).

height.$description: Default text field (`[data-size=default]{height:var(--space-32)}`); small is size.control.small.

border.$description: `--input-field-border-color:var(--color-border-secondary)`, drawn as a 1 px ring; transparent while focused.

height.$description: Default dropdown button (`height:var(--space-32)`); small is size.control.small.

bg.$description: Gray badge (`[data-color=gray]{background-color:var(--color-surface-token)}`); coloured badges use the hue at 10% (`--blue-transparent`).

radius.$description: Interactive row corner (`border-radius:var(--space-8)`). The card corner fits 10.5pt (reading `radius.settings.card`, dark), so cards are about 10.

itemBg.$description: `.grid__itemContent{background-color:var(--fg-5)}`; selected draws a 2 px ring of selection-80 inside a 3 px ring of bg-80.

successGlow.$description: Success toast glow (`--gradient-base-color:rgb(from var(--green) r g b / 26%)`), worked out.

page.$description: The launcher window as painted: `--color-window-bg: var(--bg-40)` with a vertical gradient to `--color-window-bg-secondary` over the macOS window material, so no declaration gives it. Use this as the page colour. Reading `px.window.main`.

settingsPage.$description: The Settings window as painted, behind its cards. Reading `px.window.settings`.

surface.$description: Settings card fill: `.settings-ui__sectionContent{background-color:rgb(from var(--fg) r g b / 2.5%)}`.

sidebar.$description: The Settings sidebar as painted. Reading `px.sidebar`.

dialog.$description: Dialog panel: `[dark]{--dialog-panel-bg-color:hsl(from var(--bg) h s 10%)}`, `[light]{... 95%}`, worked out from the theme's black or white background. It equals the painted launcher window (role.page).

scrim.$description: Dialog overlay (`.dialog-primitive__overlay{background-color:#0000004d}`); the alert overlay is #00000066.

windowBase.$description: Declared window base colour; not what the window paints (see page). `--color-window-base: #262626` on `.theme-root[dark]`.

focus.$description: Focus ring colour on macOS: `--color-border-focus-ring: rgb(from var(--fg) r g b / 30%)`, drawn 2 px wide (core.size.focusRing).

inputField.$description: White at 5% in both themes. `--color-surface-input-field: #ffffff0d` on `.theme-root`.

default.$description: `--accent: var(--color-system-accent, var(--theme-accent))`: the theme's accent unless macOS supplies one. The switch track paints #4FA3F8 (reading `px.switch.on`), so on this Mac the theme accent is in use.

pressed.$description: Pressed switch track: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent), white 10%)`, worked out.

danger.$description: Errors, destructive buttons (`.base-button[data-variant=destructive]` on red-20), invalid fields (red-40 border).

brand.$description: Raycast's red, the same in every theme. `--color-brand: #ff6363` on `.theme-root`.

subtitle.$description: Row subtitle and accessory, text style `text`.

width.$description: Medium switch on macOS (`--switch-width: round(calc(36 * var(--spx)), 1px)`); reading `size.switch` 36x16pt.

thumbWidth.$description: Medium switch thumb on macOS (`--switch-thumb-width`); 13 px tall (16 less 1.5 px padding each side at 2x).

onBg.$description: `.switch__root[aria-checked=true]{background-color:var(--accent)}`; fg at 30% when the window is not key.

height.$description: Medium button; mini, small and large are core.size.control.*.

padding.$description: Medium button inline padding (`.button-primitive__root[data-size=medium]{padding-inline:var(--space-16)}`; 12 beside an icon).

height.$description: Default text field (`[data-size=default]{height:var(--space-32)}`); small is size.control.small.

border.$description: `--input-field-border-color:var(--color-border-secondary)`, drawn as a 1 px ring; transparent while focused.

height.$description: Default dropdown button (`height:var(--space-32)`); small is size.control.small.

bg.$description: Gray badge (`[data-color=gray]{background-color:var(--color-surface-token)}`); coloured badges use the hue at 10% (`--blue-transparent`).

radius.$description: Interactive row corner (`border-radius:var(--space-8)`). The card corner fits 10.5pt (reading `radius.settings.card`, dark), so cards are about 10.

itemBg.$description: `.grid__itemContent{background-color:var(--fg-5)}`; selected draws a 2 px ring of selection-80 inside a 3 px ring of bg-80.

successGlow.$description: Success toast glow (`--gradient-base-color:rgb(from var(--green) r g b / 26%)`), worked out.

failureGlow.$description: Failure toast glow (red at 26%), worked out.
